title: Full-Body Endurance Circuit for Weight Loss

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through each rep, sync movement with breathing. Arch on inhale, round on exhale.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the movement, keep hips engaged. Don't rush—focus on opening hips gradually.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.cues: Light, quick pace. Drive heels toward glutes. Keep arms pumping naturally at sides.

items.name: Burpees
items.cues: Full range of motion: squat down, jump back to plank, lower chest, jump feet to hands, explosively jump up. Breathe throughout.

items.name: Bear Crawl
items.cues: Stay in a tight plank position. Move diagonally or in a line. Keep hips level. Maintain core tension throughout.

items.name: Bicycle Crunch
items.cues: Controlled tempo, no neck pulling. Bring opposite elbow to knee in a twisting motion. Keep lower back pressed to floor.

items.name: Agility Ladder Run
items.cues: If no ladder available, simulate with quick directional footwork. Focus on rapid foot placement and cardiovascular effort. Maintain RPE 5-6.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly. Squeeze glute and core. Return to start with control. Keep hips stable, no rotation.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each leg 45 seconds. Keep heel down and toes pointing forward. Lean gently forward to deepen stretch.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.cues: Knees wide, big toes together, sink hips back toward heels. Rest forehead on ground. Breathe deeply and relax.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place arms against wall at shoulder height, palms up. Step forward gently until stretch is felt in biceps and shoulders. Hold steady.

rationale: User is returning from extended rest (999 days), so workout emphasizes moderate-intensity endurance circuits with bodyweight exercises to rebuild conditioning and work toward weight loss goal without excessive joint stress.

RPE 5-6 intensity target achieved through continuous movement patterns (burpees, bear crawls, ladder drills) that elevate heart rate while allowing recovery between sets, appropriate for intermediate fitness level with no equipment limitations.

45-minute duration balanced with warmup mobility work, mixed endurance/strength main circuit targeting full body, and thorough cooldown to aid recovery and prevent delayed-onset soreness after extended training gap.
